name: Network lookup
summary: Ports, IP addresses, subnets and HTTP status codes
author: friday-core
description: Network facts without a network call. It holds 4 tools and picks the right one from what you ask. Port lookup: Looks up well-known TCP and UDP ports (SSH 22, HTTPS 443, RDP 3389, SMB 445 and more) with a safety note, and the ports FRIDAY and its tools use: the kernel on 8765, Ollama on 11434 and the Vite dev server. IP address inspector: Reads IPv4 and IPv6 addresses from text and classifies each one: private LAN, loopback, link-local, carrier-grade shared, documentation, multicast, reserved or public. Also shows the integer and hex form of an IPv4 address and expands IPv6. CIDR calculator: IPv4 subnet maths from a CIDR such as 192.168.1.0/24 or an address with a mask: network, broadcast, mask, wildcard, first and last usable host, host count and the kind of range (private, loopback, link-local, carrier-grade NAT, multicast, public). Also tells whether given addresses are inside the network. /31 and /32 are handled as the special cases they are. HTTP status explainer: Explains the common HTTP status codes (200 to 511, with the Cloudflare 52x family) and the error names that appear in logs (ENOTFOUND, ECONNRESET, ETIMEDOUT, ECONNREFUSED, EADDRINUSE, CERT_HAS_EXPIRED, UNABLE_TO_VERIFY_LEAF_SIGNATURE and more) with what to try. A status outside the list is reported as not covered, never guessed.
